Other examples of reboots that work are the Captain America movies, while they both had their flaws they were worlds above the one from 1990. That one was a serious piece of drivel. Same goes for The Punisher, and I think the Daredevil series on Netflix plays out way better than the movie, although that was more the fault of the producers. Love the first two Batman movies from Tim Burton, didn't stop me from loving the Chris Nolan ones.
